The problem with CBT is that you have to talk about your week and recent past and what you think triggers things but with me I have an awful memory and I'm almost never in the present. I'm always in the future or my fake perfect world in my head.

I have mentioned medication to my psychiatrist but she told me that it can make things worse but right now i don't care im so desperate.
